newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly flat Friday as players wait out the expiry of the July contract, dealers said.
They expect the July/October switch to continue to widen ahead of Monday's expiry. The spread closed at a 0.14 cent premium basis October on Thursday compared with 0.11 cent Wednesday.
Nearby resistance was pegged at 11.34 cents a lb followed by 11.42 cents for October, with support at 11.00 cents, then 10.96 cents.
Wednesday, spot July ended down 0.04 cent at 11.11 cents, traded 11.19 to 11.10 cents. October settled 0.01 cent easier at 11.25 cents, with the rest 0.01 and 0.02 cent firmer.
In London, white sugar futures rose Friday on steady trade buying. At 0843 EDT/1243 GMT, the spot August contract
stood $1.10 higher at $320.50, while the rest of the board was trading $0.20 to $0.80 firmer.
